name: Kotoba Pocket
pageTitle: Kotoba Pocket — A little pocket for new words.
description: Keep words you discover on the web, together with their source pages. A simple, local-first Chrome extension in English and Japanese.
eyebrow: A little pocket for new words.
heroTitle:
Find a new word.
Keep it close.
heroBody: A word to look up. A phrase to remember. Select it, save it, and come back to the original page later. A small vocabulary notebook that keeps up with your reading.
release: Chrome extension · Coming to the Web Store
demoLabel: Illustration of the workflow, not a live saving interface.
articleTitle: A new way to find your words.
articleBefore: An unexpected discovery can feel like
articleAfter: . Keep the words that catch your attention, and make them part of your everyday vocabulary.
featureTitle: For reading now. And remembering later.
feature1Body: Use the right-click menu, a keyboard shortcut, or the extension’s save button. Choose whatever fits your reading rhythm.
feature2Body: Save the word with its page title, URL, and timestamp. Return to the original page whenever you like. The same word won’t be saved twice.
feature3Title: Yours to keep. Yours to export.
feature3Body: Browse your collection and remove words you no longer need. Export everything as a Japanese-friendly CSV file.
howTitle: Catch the word while it’s there.
step1Body: Highlight a word or short phrase on a regular web page as you read.
step2Body: Choose “Save to Kotoba Pocket” from the right-click menu, use the save button, or press your shortcut.
step3Body: Open the extension to browse your words, revisit source pages, or download a CSV.
shortcutBody: Save your selection without leaving the keyboard. Change the keys in Chrome’s extension shortcut settings.
shortcutNote: If another extension uses the same keys, check the assigned shortcut in the popup.
privacyBody: Your saved vocabulary and source information stay in Chrome on this device. The extension has no ads or analytics and does not send your words to an external server.
privacyNote: Uninstalling the extension removes local entries. Export important vocabulary as CSV to keep a copy.
readyTitle: Give your reading a little pocket.
readyBody: A simple Chrome extension in English and Japanese. We’re preparing for the Chrome Web Store release.
footerNote: A little pocket for new words.
